## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
Identity and access: staff users (`SEC_USER`, realm STAFF) and customer accounts (realm CUSTOMER, self-registration
and verification), roles and the three-level Module → Screen → Action grants, the permission catalog
(`SEC_MODULE_REG` / `SEC_SCREEN_REG` / `SEC_ACTION_REG`, global, synchronised at startup from every
`PermissionContributor`), JWT login on two filter chains, sessions, password reset, sign-up requests, the security
audit log and dashboard. The authority of an action is `PERM_<SCREEN>_<ACTION>`; `VIEW` is the gateway action of a
screen (RULE-SEC-007).
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
Every module: it declares its screens and actions in one `PermissionContributor` and guards every service method with
`@PreAuthorize("hasAuthority(T(<base.package>.<module>.permission.<Module>Permissions).PERM_…)")`. To show or
contact a user (name, e-mail, active) without touching `SEC_USER`: `SecUserDirectoryApi`. To know whether a
module is switched on: `SecModuleRegistryApi.isModuleActive`. `SecAdminRecoveryApi` is for the platform
operator's recovery flows only. A customer-facing module (erp-core 1.6.0): its customer endpoints keep their own
`@PreAuthorize` — a customer token carries `ROLE_CUSTOMER` plus the permissions of the account's CUSTOMER-realm
roles; the subscriber administrator marks such a role `defaultForCustomers` and sec assigns it to every new customer
account in the creating transaction (outbox event `sec.CustomerAccountDefaultRolesAssigned {userId, roleCodes}`);
`SecCustomerDefaultRoleApi.defaultRoles()` tells the module what new accounts receive. To let the person behind an address act on a record the module owns with a customer account of the same tenant — without the module minting, storing or expiring a secret — `SecCustomerInvitationApi` (erp-core 1.6.0, CCR-PRT-001): `issue` delivers the accept link through NOTIF with the module's template, `redeem` (called from the module's customer endpoint with the signed-in customer's id) returns the opaque subject it was issued for, `revoke` / `find` / `listBySubject` manage it; three outbox events `sec.CustomerInvitationIssued` / `Redeemed` / `Revoked`.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
@Component
public class ShopPermissions implements PermissionContributor {
    public static final String PERM_SHOP_ORDERS_VIEW = "PERM_SHOP_ORDERS_VIEW";
    private static final PermissionScreen ORDERS = new PermissionScreen("SHOP", "SHOP_ORDERS", "الطلبات", "Orders");
    public List<PermissionModule> modules() { return List.of(new PermissionModule("SHOP", "المتجر", "Shop")); }
    public List<PermissionScreen> screens() { return List.of(ORDERS); }
    public List<PermissionDef> permissions() { return List.of(PermissionDef.of(ORDERS, "VIEW", "عرض")); }
}

@PreAuthorize("hasAuthority(T(com.acme.shop.permission.ShopPermissions).PERM_SHOP_ORDERS_VIEW)")
public ServiceResult<OrderResponse> getById(Long id) { … }

// the approver's contact for a notification variable
Optional<UserContact> approver = secUserDirectoryApi.findContact(order.getApproverUserId());

// erp-core 1.6.0 — a customer-facing module's readiness check: the roles every new customer account receives
List<RoleRef> defaults = secCustomerDefaultRoleApi.defaultRoles();   // RoleRef(roleId, roleCode, nameAr, nameEn); empty = none marked

// erp-core 1.6.0 — invite the lessee's contact (staff side, inside the module's own transaction; the module has checked its permission)
InvitationHandle handle = secCustomerInvitationApi.issue(new IssueInvitation("PRT", "LESSEE", lessee.getRef(), "EMAIL",
    lessee.getContactEmail(), "ar", "PRT_INVITE", Map.of("lesseeName", lessee.getName()), Duration.ofDays(3), "/portal/accept"));
preferences.setInvitationId(handle.invitationId());            // never the secret: it travels only in the mailed link's fragment

// the module's customer endpoint: the secret from the page's URL fragment, the account from the session — never from the body's claims
RedeemedInvitation redeemed = secCustomerInvitationApi.redeem(secretFromFragment, currentCustomerUserId);
link(redeemed.subjectRef(), redeemed.redeemedBy());            // INVITATION_NOT_FOUND | _EXPIRED | _REVOKED | _ALREADY_REDEEMED |
                                                               // NOT_A_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT | INVITATION_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED roll this transaction back
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
